Title: Nintendo Switch Archive or Delete Game Guide
IntroLines: Wondering whether you should archive or delete a game on your Nintendo Switch?
In this video, I'll show you the exact difference and how to do both to free up storage space.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: HOW TO ARCHIVE A GAME (KEEP THE ICON)
Steps: •  First, highlight the game you want to archive on your HOME Menu.
•  Press the " + " button on your Joy-Con or controller to open options.
•  Move down the left menu and select " Manage Software " .
•  Select " Archive Software " on the right side.
•  Select " Archive " to confirm.
•  This removes the game data to free up space while keeping your save data safe.
•  Notice the game icon stays on your HOME Menu with a small cloud download icon.
•  Finally, select the game icon anytime you want to quickly redownload it.
Sections.Bridge: If you want to completely remove the game and declutter your home screen, here's how to delete it.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: HOW TO DELETE A GAME (REMOVE THE ICON)
Steps: •  First, highlight the game you want to delete on your HOME Menu.
•  Press the " + " button on your controller to open software options.
•  Scroll down and select " Manage Software " .
•  Select " Delete Software " from the menu.
•  Select " Delete " to confirm the deletion.
•  Don't worry, your game save data is stored separately and will not be erased.
•  Notice that both the game data and the game icon are now removed from your screen.
•  Finally, check your HOME Menu to confirm the icon is gone and your space is freed.
Sections.Bridge: If you want to free up massive storage by archiving several games at once, let's use Quick Archive.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 3: BULK ARCHIVE MULTIPLE GAMES AT ONCE
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open " System Settings " from the bottom toolbar.
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select " Data Management " .
•  On the right side, select " Quick Archive " .
•  Check the box next to any games you are not currently playing.
•  Look at the bottom of the screen to see the total storage space you will free up.
•  Select " Archive Data " on the right.
•  Select " Archive " to confirm.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and check your newly available storage space.

OutroLines: And that's the difference between archiving and deleting games on your Nintendo Switch, and how to do both.
